atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='1000ms'/>G'day mates! Here are some facts about New Zealand. New Zealand has 3.5 million inhabitants on an area of 270 thousand square kilometres. Our capital city is Wellington. <break time='700ms'/> Wellington has been my home for as long as I can remember. What I like most about living in New Zealand is its incredible nature and the endless activities you can do. Whether surfing, hiking or bungee jumping, there really is something for everyone here. My friends and I love spending time outdoors together, and we always have heaps of fun.

atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='1000ms'/>Did you know that New Zealand was one of the last countries in the world to be inhabited? It was first settled by the Maori, New Zealand's indigenous people. They have a strong spiritual connection to their country. The Maori are also the ones who gave the Kiwi its name. This flightless bird is New Zealand's heraldic animal, and it is only found here. Unfortunately, since predators like rats were brought to New Zealand in colonial times, the Kiwi has been endangered. This is why New Zealand wants to become predator free until 2050. What do you think about this? Cheers! Eli.
